name: microtube-monorepo
description: MicroTube — terminal + web binaural synthesis studio over a shared Rust/Wasm DSP core.

scripts.wasm:build: wasm-pack build crates/core --target web --out-dir ../../apps/web/public/microtube-worklet/wasm --dev -- --features wasm && node apps/web/scripts/build-worklet.mjs
scripts.wasm:build:release: wasm-pack build crates/core --target web --out-dir ../../apps/web/public/microtube-worklet/wasm -- --features wasm && node apps/web/scripts/build-worklet.mjs
scripts.wasm:watch: cargo watch -w crates/core/src -w crates/core/Cargo.toml -s "npm run wasm:build"
scripts.dev: npm run wasm:build && concurrently -n wasm,vite -c yellow,cyan "npm run wasm:watch" "npm run dev --workspace @microtube/web"
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build:release && npm run build --workspace @microtube/web
